transcript.content: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what's been bringing you in to see me today?

What scared me enough to come in is that I keep thinking it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. And sometimes driving home from the clinic, I catch myself wondering what would happen if I just didn’t turn the wheel.
When you have these thoughts about not waking up or not turning the wheel, do you feel like you actually want to end your life, or is it more a passive wish that things could just stop?

It’s more like… I want everything to stop. I keep thinking it would be easier not to wake up. But when I’m driving, I do catch myself wondering what would happen if I just didn’t turn the wheel, and that scares me.
Have you ever had a period, lasting several days or more, where you felt unusually energetic, elated, or needed much less sleep than usual, in a way that was different from how you normally feel?
Yes. There was a stretch where I was sleeping maybe three hours a night, getting up before sunrise, and I still felt sharp. I really thought I didn’t need any more sleep.
During this depressive period, have you experienced anything like hearing voices, seeing things others don't, or having beliefs that others found strange or untrue?
No, I haven’t noticed anything like that.
Over the past couple of weeks, how has this been affecting your ability to go to work, take care of yourself, or keep up with daily responsibilities?

It’s affecting pretty much everything. I’ve started making mistakes at the clinic, and I’m avoiding friends because I’m afraid I’ll snap at someone or just fall apart. At home, my husband has had to take over the bills and meals… and he’s been helping keep me safe when the thoughts get really dark.
How long have you been feeling this way—down, low energy, and struggling like this—continuously?
About 11 months now, I think. It was there even before this last month, but lately it’s become unbearable.
Thinking back to that period when you felt unusually energetic and needed little sleep, how many days in a row did that last?
It’s been about a month, this whole intense up-and-down period around taking in our relative.

During that month when you felt energetic and needed less sleep, were you also feeling down, hopeless, or having those thoughts of not wanting to wake up at the very same time, or did that happen during a separate stretch when you were feeling more your usual depressed self?

It was at the same time. Even when I had all that energy, I kept thinking it would be easier if I just didn’t wake up. Driving home from the clinic, I’ve caught myself wondering what would happen if I just didn’t turn the wheel. That’s what scared me enough to come in.
